name: arma3-sqf-reloader
description: Hot-reloads SQF functions in a running Arma 3 (or Eden Editor) through the SqfReloader plugin. Also provides ability to run SQF code from the vscode editor.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: SqfReloader launches Arma 3, writes into the Arma installation and executes SQF in the running game, so it requires a trusted workspace.

virtualWorkspaces.description: SqfReloader links real folders into the Arma installation and needs file system paths.

languageModelTools.name: armaAiTool
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Interact with the currently running Arma 3 session through SqfReloader. Before answering questions that depend on the live game or evaluating code without current session context, call action=context first and use its returned mode, mission, role flags, loaded mods, activated addons, API address, and SqfReloader log-file path. Use action=status for a lightweight connectivity check. Use action=eval to run SQF and return its result; evaluation can change live game state and requires user confirmation. After every evaluation, call action=rpt and inspect the current Arma RPT for new 'Error in expression', 'Error', or related script diagnostics before deciding whether the SQF worked; an ok API response means only that evaluation was submitted, not that the SQF completed without errors. Use the timestamps and context to distinguish new diagnostics from older log entries. Call action=rpt whenever the user asks about current script errors. The context's isServer flag describes the connected instance, not a separately running server.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Read live Arma context and RPT script errors, check connectivity, or evaluate SQF in Arma.

action.description: Use context first for live session details, status for connectivity, eval to execute SQF, and rpt to read the current Arma script log.

code.description: SQF expression or statements to execute when action is eval.

sqfReloader.arma3ToolsDirectory.description: Optional global Arma 3 Tools install directory (or full path to AddonBuilder.exe). When set, this path is used instead of registry discovery.

sqfReloader.functionLinks.description: Resolve Arma function names (e.g. TAG_fnc_myFunction) in .sqf files: Ctrl+click opens the matching fn_myFunction.sqf, and hovering shows its header documentation (description, parameters, returns).

sqfReloader.globalVariableLinks.description: Resolve global variables in .sqf files (e.g. TAG_myVariable): jump to their definition across the workspace. Hovering lists the definitions with their code.

sqfReloader.localVariableLinks.description: Resolve file-local variables in .sqf files (private _myValue = ..., _myValue2 = ... and params entries): jump to their definition in the open file. Hovering lists the definitions with their code.

sqfReloader.hemtt.enabled.markdownDescription: Run `hemtt check` for every HEMTT project in the workspace (any folder containing `.hemtt/project.toml`) and show its errors and warnings in the Problems panel. Requires the `hemtt` command to be installed.

sqfReloader.hemtt.onSave.markdownDescription: Run `hemtt check` for the project that contains a saved `.sqf`, `.cpp`, `.hpp`, `.cfg`, `.sqm` or `.toml` file.

sqfReloader.hemtt.unsaved.markdownDescription: Also check files that are edited but not saved yet. `hemtt check` reads from disk, so the unsaved buffers of the project are written into a temporary shadow copy of it and HEMTT runs there; the project's real files are never changed.

sqfReloader.hemtt.lints.markdownDescription: Explicit lints passed to `hemtt check` as `-L <lint>` (for example `s01-invalid-command`). Empty runs only the lints enabled by the project config.

sqfReloader.hemtt.executable.markdownDescription: Full path to `hemtt`/`hemtt.exe`. Leave empty to use the `hemtt` command from `PATH`.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run clean && npm run compile
scripts.verify: npm run compile && npm run verify:version && node scripts/verify-links.js && node scripts/verify-tutorial.js && node scripts/verify-hemtt-shim.js && node scripts/verify-template.js && node scripts/verify-tags.js
